# Vendored third-party code

## `bdh.py`
Unmodified copy of the official Dragon Hatchling reference implementation from
<https://github.com/pathwaycom/bdh> (Pathway Technology, Inc.), MIT licensed — see `LICENSE-bdh`.

Vendored rather than pip-installed so the exact bytes we trained against are pinned in-repo.
**Do not edit this file.** Any variant we need (materialized σ, ablations) belongs in our own
modules and must import from here, so the reference path stays byte-identical to upstream.

Upstream README states the public code is the *baseline variant* and does not reproduce
Pathway's internally-reported Sudoku Extreme result. No pretrained weights are published.
